storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has denied allegations of the country's involvement in a drone strike in Kuwait that resulted in the deaths of two Italian nationals. He described the accusations as baseless and labeled the incident as 'suspicious,' offering to cooperate on a joint investigation. In response, Kuwait condemned the strike as 'heinous Iranian aggression,' with additional condemnations from Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar, and the UAE.
